# Leruo Foundation

> Leruo Foundation NPC is a South African non-profit organisation focused on sustainable entrepreneurship, youth entrepreneurship, women in leadership, mentorship and economic empowerment.

Official website: https://leruofoundation.org
Primary language: English (South Africa)

## Core programmes

- Youthpreneurs Programme: https://leruofoundation.org/youthpreneurs
- Branding Chief Executive Circle SA: https://leruofoundation.org/brandingcircle
- Women CEOs Network: https://leruofoundation.org/womenceo
- Changemakers Graduation 2026 digital programme: https://leruofoundation.org/graduation-2026

## Organisation

- About Leruo Foundation: https://leruofoundation.org/about
- Become a Sponsor: https://leruofoundation.org/becomesponsor
- Contact: https://leruofoundation.org/contact
